title: More Than 40 Dead After a Ferry Capsizes on Zimbabwe’s Lake Kariba
summary_full: The vessel was crowded far beyond capacity and was hit by strong waves, the police said. While dozens have been rescued, the search continues for an unknown number of missing people.
